lead.en: Personal side projects I build end to end with AI. Small, fast and made to test an idea. Some will grow, some won't. This is where they live.

blurb.en: A minimalist single-task focus timer. Write one task, pick your minutes, and start. One thing at a time. Built end to end with AI.
blurb.pt: Um timer de foco minimalista para uma única tarefa. Escreva a tarefa, escolha os minutos e comece. Uma coisa de cada vez. Feito de ponta a ponta com IA.
